item.title: Obituary: Felipe García
item.description: Felipe García, longtime pastor and prominent community member, died Jan. 28. He was 79.

item.title: Celebrating Churches: FBC Muleshoe completes sanctuary renovation
item.description: First Baptist Church of Muleshoe celebrated the completion of a $650,000 renovation project on its sanctuary.

item.title: Travis Kerns to be nominated for SBC recording secretary
item.description: Southern Baptist Theological Seminary professor Denny Burk has announced plans to nominate Travis Kerns, a South Carolina associational mission strategist for the Southern Baptist Convention recording secretary at the 2026 SBC annual meeting.

item.title: Football coach shaped by Jesus
item.description: Jeff Dixon, a retired educator and football coach, credits his Christian faith with shaping his approach to coaching and mentoring young athletes.

item.title: Commentary: We need an Evangelical Board of Peace
item.description: Wissam al-Saliby, 21Wilberforce president, proposes the formation of an Evangelical Board of Peace as an embodiment of God’s righteousness.

item.title: Jonathan Greer to be nominated for SBC recording secretary
item.description: A Mississippi pastor has become the third known candidate to be nominated for Southern Baptist Convention recording secretary.

item.title: Baylor Regents celebrate milestones and new program
item.description: The Baylor University Board of Regents celebrated fundraising, graduation milestones, and introduced a Bachelor of Science in biomedical engineering.

item.title: Russia/Ukraine war entering fourth year
item.description: Feb. 24, 2026 marks the fourth anniversary of Russia’s full-scale military invasion of Ukraine. Ukrainian and Texas Baptists commented on the occasion.

item.title: Equip: The importance of learning the biblical languages
item.description: Joshua Sharp explains the importance of learning Greek and Hebrew for studying Scripture and suggests resources.

item.title: Voices: Ten Commandments law and adult hypocrisies
item.description: The Ten Commandments are “ordered” by law to be posted in Texas public schools. The intent? Because we supposedly “support Judeo-Christian values.” Yet, the Ten Commandments are Mosaic, not Christian....
